note: ALL-SPOT population: every compare-flagged spot regardless of poseVerified. This, not the poseVerified-filtered population, is what PR #27's merge condition (serenity <=16.58, kings-court <=22.44) was scored against -- see metrics/README.md, "What this means for the merge condition". Produced by a one-off script (scratchpad/all_spots_delta_e.py) that imports delta_e.py's own cell_means()/ciede2000() unmodified, not a committed tool. This file's meanFullPrecision is left null on purpose: it was computed by averaging already-per-spot-rounded values (a scripting inconsistency fixed before the repeat run), not the true unrounded per-spot mean. The rounded mean (16.57) is unaffected and is the number every comparison in task 9 cites. See serenity-b2-task9-legacy-repeat-allspots.json for a run with a genuine full-precision figure.
caveat: Absolute values are meaningless: render and photograph differ in lens, exposure and furniture model. Only the trend between phases carries information.
